safeBox.note: Paid, not organic. An in-feed ad adds a CTA button and a Sponsored label, and marketing/README.md puts that at roughly 370 px on top of the organic bottom allowance of 422 — so the floor for anything that must be read is 1920 − 792 = 1128, not 1498. That is the single biggest constraint on this video and the reason every line of type sits high.

beats.startSecNote: Not 4.2. The transcript this sheet animates has pauses in it, and every tile goes blank during one — the window starting at 4.2 put a silence under the word 'Nine looks', which reads as the app having stopped. 6.4 also reaches the scroll, so the sheet visibly goes past six presets to Headline, Neon and Newsprint: the claim is made on screen rather than only in the voiceover.
